item.title: Iceland volcano erupts near Grindavik, forcing evacuation
item.description: A volcano on the Reykjanes peninsula in Iceland has erupted near the fishing town of Grindavik, forcing the evacuation of residents and the Blue Lagoon spa.

item.title: UK inflation falls to 2.1% in September
item.description: Consumer price inflation in the United Kingdom eased last month as fuel and food costs dropped, official statistics show.
